data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): The SKILL.md Two-Pass subsection must specify the helper's invocation altitude — Phase C is epic-scoped, so document that the helper is invoked once per epic (enumerating descendant stories) BEFORE ticket next-batch, that repeated per-batch invocation is safe due to helper idempotency (no once-per-story guard needed), and where the story enumeration comes from. Verify: grep -qiE 'epic|per-batch|idempotent|descendant' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
